english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal warrior, soldier, or combatant.

exampleSentences.english: A warrior guarded the front line all night.
exampleSentences.traditional: 一個戰士喺前線守咗成晚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jat1 go3 zin3 si6 hai2 cin4 sin3 sau2 zo2 seng4 maan5

english.note: Use 戰士 for a fighting soldier or warrior, not for every enlisted service member.

exampleSentences.english: In this film, the soldier charged out to save people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢套戲入面，個戰士為咗救人衝咗出去。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 go3 zin3 si6 wai6 zo2 gau3 jan4 cung1 zo2 ceot1 heoi3

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person engaged in fighting, especially in combat or for a cause.

exampleSentences.english: This fighter held his ground on the front line to protect the villagers.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位戰士喺前線為咗保護村民，堅持到最後。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wai2 zin3 si6 hai2 cin4 sin3 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 cyun1 man4 gin1 ci4 dou3 zeoi3 hau6
